item.title: Italy clamps down as the season kicks off
item.description:
What moved (outside the US)
- Italy — ADM’s new block order hit deadline Aug 20: Italy’s customs and monopolies agency (ADM) instructed ISPs to block 190 additional gambling domains, with enforcement due by Aug 20.
